text: 伦敦金属交易所（LME）将于10月27日正式挂牌LME上海热轧卷板合约，以上海期货交易所（下称“上期所”）热轧卷板期货结算价为基准。这是金属类“上海价格”首次输出境外成熟市场。记者在伦敦金属交易所周的上市前研讨会上注意到，到场国际贸易商和基金经理均表示：过去几年，他们在中国出口商面前“只有一条腿”。换言之，中国同行在现货之外还能用上期所期货对冲，而他们却只有现货这一条腿可用。上期所总经理鲁东升在会上表示，上期所热轧卷板期货价格已逐步成为亚太、中东、北非和南美等地区进口中国板材的重要参考。在他看来，“一个合约的持续健康发展，关键在于扎根实体产业、回应市场需
text_en: The London Metal Exchange (LME) will officially list the LME Shanghai Hot-Rolled Coil contract on October 27, based on the settlement price of the hot-rolled coil futures of the Shanghai Futures Exchange (SHFE). This is the first time a metals "Shanghai price" has been exported to a mature overseas market. At a pre-listing seminar during LME Week, the reporter noted that international traders and fund managers present said that in past years they had "only one leg" compared with Chinese exporters. In other words, their Chinese counterparts could hedge with SHFE futures in addition to spot, while they had only spot, one leg, available. SHFE General Manager Lu Dongsheng said at the meeting that the SHFE hot-rolled coil futures price has gradually become an important reference for imports of Chinese flat steel in regions including Asia-Pacific, the Middle East, North Africa and South America. In his view, "the key to the sustained and healthy development of a contract lies in taking root in the real economy and responding to market needs"
